subject: Any update?
body: Hi, just checking in on my site. Is it ready yet? Thanks!
How long until the website is done? You said a few days last week and I have not heard anything since.

subject: When will proofs arrive
body: Hello, when will you send the three proofs? Excited to see them.

subject: Question about my order
body: What is the status of my order? I paid last Tuesday.

subject: Still waiting
body: I am still waiting to hear back. Can you tell me where things stand?
When will the logo change be done?

subject: Logo swap
body: Please replace the logo with the attached PNG. The old one is outdated.

subject: Small edits
body: Can you change my phone number on the contact page to the new one? Also remove the map section.

subject: Revision request
body: I reviewed proof two and want one more round. Please adjust the headline text and swap the hero image.
Add a photo of my storefront to the home page and take off the testimonials section.

subject: New version please
body: This draft is not what I pictured. I need a different layout for the services page.

subject: Invoice question
body: Hi, I did not receive an invoice for my payment. Can you send a receipt?

subject: Charge on my card
body: There is a charge from your company on my credit card that I do not recognize. Please explain or refund it.
What is the price for hosting renewal after the first year?

subject: Billing issue
body: I think I was billed twice this month for the same subscription fee.
Do I pay again when the domain renews, or is that included?

subject: Site is down
body: My website is not working at all. Visitors say it shows an error page.

subject: Cannot log in
body: I am locked out of my account and the password reset email never arrives.
The site is really slow and sometimes times out when loading the gallery page.

subject: 404 errors
body: Getting a 404 error on my contact page since yesterday.
After the update the whole page is broken, just a white screen.

subject: Re: FAM-260822-00065
body: Customer reply captured from the controlled mailbox fixture.

subject: Hello
body: Hey there, hope you are having a good week!

subject: Do you make logos too?
body: A friend recommended you. Do you also design business cards?

subject: Refund and cancel
body: Please refund my last payment and change my card on file so it does not happen again.

subject: Site slow AND wrong hours
body: Two things. The site has been slow all week, and please update my store hours to open at 9am.

subject: Is it live yet?
body: Is my site live yet? If so can you change the tagline before launch?
